{{Quote|It involves the ''current'' Duke of Serenno.|[[Aveca Dunn]]|<ref name="AotE9">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 4|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 4]]</ref>}}
'''Duke of Serenno''' was a noble title. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] it was held by [[Rodas Borgin]] of [[House Borgin/Legends|House Borgin]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the publisher's summary of [[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 4|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 4]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Bron Dooku|Bron]] of [[House Dooku]] was mistakenly referred to as the young Duke of Serenno.<ref name="AotE9" />
